verdict.rationale: The Jules API exposes an optional `automationMode` field on sessions. The docs say that by default no PR is created automatically, which implies the field is the setting that turns on automatic PR creation. The product also documents that it creates PRs of its changes, and community users report finding PRs ready to review. Missing for 10: the specific automationMode value and its behavior are not documented, auto-PR configuration is not described outside the API (e.g. web app or GitHub-label tasks), and no hands-on report confirms automatic PR creation through the API setting.

support.subject: As a developer, I can configure an agent to automatically open a pull request when its task completes

citations.quote: The `automationMode` field is optional. By default, no PR will be automatically created.
Jules creates a PR of the changes.
By the time I get home in the evening I've got a few PRs to review.
